about_short_description.short_description: Paper is an digital canvas designed to help designers create, share, and ship their work.

product.name: Paper Canvas
product.description: A digital canvas tool designed for designers to create, share, and ship design work with real-time collaboration and design-to-code capabilities.

product.name: AI Pencil Tool
product.description: An AI-assisted design feature that allows designers to direct AI-generated content through voice, text, or minimal input to enhance creative workflows.

product.name: Paper Shaders
product.description: A feature for creating and managing shader assets within the Paper platform, enabling designers to build and showcase visual effects.

product.name: Layout Panel
product.description: A design interface panel within Paper that enables users to create and adjust flexible layout systems using visual alignment controls and constraints.

product.name: Paper
product.description: A professional design tool where each layer is real HTML and CSS, enabling direct code-design workflows and AI-assisted editing.
